headline: Chiefs extend their lead with field goal
what_happened: H.Butker successfully kicked a 28-yard field goal, which is worth 3 points, to put more points on the board for the Chiefs.
who: H.Butker kicked the ball, supported by J.Winchester and M.Araiza.
why_it_matters: This successful kick increases the Chiefs' lead to 7 points. It slightly boosts their chances of winning the game by 2 percentage points.
